crossRefs.note: It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well…
then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to…
Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.
For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.
He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose…

translations.web: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’
translations.bsb: But if the servant declares, ‘I love my master and my wife and children; I do not want to go free,’
translations.kjv: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
translations.asv: But if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
